ToGetServiceHierarchy: to inspect the recursive service tree
to show the service inheritance tree

ActionDescriptions.ToGetServiceHierarchy:
to inspect the recursive service tree
Returns the recursive service hierarchy rooted at the Service base prototype so singleton and per-binding services can be inspected as a tree.
ActionDescriptions.ToListServices:
to enumerate protoscript services
Returns the full recursive flat list of available ProtoScript-backed services by reading all descendants of the Service base prototype.
